gold: Mirror-image dextrocardia with acute inferior wall and right ventricular myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion

selector.rationale: The patient's elevated serum troponin I level and ST-segment elevations in multiple leads are indicative of acute myocardial infarction, which is further supported by the total occlusion in the proximal right coronary artery found on coronary angiography.

rejected.label: Cor pulmonale
rejected.why: Lack of strong evidence supporting cor pulmonale, with only one supporting note and no clear indication of pulmonary hypertension or right ventricular hypertrophy.
